query.text: 请陪我办公，我询问工具或设备的用法时请给出操作指导。
query.text_en: Please assist me while I work and provide operating guidance when I ask how to use a tool or device.

annotation.text_zh: 拉开打印机下方的纸盘，就可以放纸了。
annotation.text_en: Just pull out the paper tray under the printer to load paper.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
